text_block_list.text:
Due to administrative procedures,
Still in 
Love was left to do voluntary training
for 
just the final hour, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's already time to wrap up... 
though.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If only I could get just a bit better 
results... Trainer would be happy—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer-san... Are you done with work? 
...Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry for doing this on my own. 
It's just that I felt so good today...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I may have your permission, I would 
like to continue a little longer... What 
do you think...?
choice_data_list: Hmm, if there's a lookout with us,...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The lookout... Trainer, is that you?
choice_data_list: Hmm, if we have someone keeping wa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No...! I never intended to hide 
it...!
I was planning to contact you first 
anyway—
choice_data_list: Right, don't go training in secret...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Aaaah... What should I do...? Did I make 
them angry...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm sor—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! T-Trainer-san... Could it be that you 
were... t-teasing me...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Geez... please don't tease me...
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I was worried about you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... thank you for keeping me in 
mind and worrying about me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure this time... is not 
wasted in the slightest.

Even if condition is good, one must be 
careful not to overdo it.
Carelessness can 
lead to accidents.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! N-No, no. It's quite all right... I 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I have always known... that more than 
anything, more than anyone, you are 
thinking of me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Having you scold me like that, Trainer... 
felt... well, rather rare...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that you're worried about me... 
has made me so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
W-Was that inappropriate of me...? I'm 
terribly――
choice_data_list: When you say it like that again, i...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah... Err...
choice_data_list: Hearing you say it out loud like t...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...W-What should I do? It's catching on, 
and now my own face feels hot...)

Things somehow became awkward,
and we both 
looked away from each other.
